commits.message:
test(daemon): each steady round ends its turn, so what a render deferred runs before the next (candybar-testing-ihvy.u05)

The rounds ran back to back in one turn, so a rebuild a render deferred to a
later turn ran after the case had read its counts and log. Each round now
yields, as statusline ticks arrive on separate turns; a view retired on a
deferred turn passes without the yield and fails with it.

The plan's ticket 42 table says its Tier is the layer each check joins: every
file it names runs in the worker tier today.

test(daemon): a steady render leaves no reload due, and a failed request logs its throw (candybar-testing-ihvy.u05)

A catch-up reloads one entry a turn, so a render that marked entries due
would rebuild after the case read its counts. The counts now carry `due`, which
the render leaves behind at once.

The failed-request case reads the daemon's log: the `handler threw` error is
the operator's only trace of the failure, and no case asserted it.

The plan's ticket 42 table records, per check, the break that fails it, as its
done line asks.

test(daemon): a steady render logs nothing, and a closed cache leaves no session-state observer (candybar-testing-ihvy.u05)

The held-counts case read `retired` and `retiredViews`, which count only
teardowns still waiting on a render, so a view rebuilt and disposed on every
render held every count flat and passed. The cache logs each entry it builds
and each view it opens or closes, so the steady rounds now assert they log
nothing; the view rebuild fails it.

The observer case compared a second walk with the first, so a click that kept
one observer per session and never released it passed. It now also closes the
cache and reads zero, and its precondition compares the walk with the bar drawn
alone rather than with a count the earlier round had already raised.

The failing handler is a one-shot jest stub, and the case's directories are
made once rather than every round.

test(daemon): the load gate's structural checks are cases at their pieces (candybar-testing-ihvy.u05)

Each behaviour the removed load gate checked besides load is one event
checked once at the piece that owns it, with no daemon and no timed run:

- Drawing: a few sessions from three directories draw again, and the
  render cache's entries, compiles, views and watches hold, none retired.
- Sources: the same renders open and close no watcher.
- Actions over Sessions: a second walk through a session's menu keeps no
  observer of the session state.
- Requests: a handler that throws is answered RENDER_FAILED, the daemon
  neither exits nor keeps it in flight, and the next request is served.

Feed pace and session writes (stage, branch switch, turn) were already
proven in process, by frame-feed, daemon-git-cache and
daemon-session-usage-store; the plan's table names where each check lives.

chore(release): set `package.json` to 1.213.2
